params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) of the analysis window. When omitted, defaults to the earliest transaction available for the entity.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) of the analysis window (inclusive — transactions on this date are included). When omitted, defaults to the current time.

items.docs:
Detects recurring inflow and outflow transactions and groups them into structured patterns, surfacing frequency, 
expected timing, and whether each pattern is ongoing, new, or stopped.
